COUNCIL MEMBERS
Adam Loraine, Mayor

CITY OF SAN MATEO
Regular Meeting Minutes
City Council
City Hall
330 W. 20th Avenue
San Mateo CA 94403
www.cityofsanmateo.org
 
August 17, 2026
City Hall, Council Chambers 7:00 PM
Regular Meeting
 
CALL TO ORDER at 7:06 p.m.
Roll Call
Present: Mayor Loraine, Deputy Mayor Fernandez, and Council Members Diaz Nash and Newsom.
Absent: Cwirko-Godycki (excused)
CEREMONIAL
1. JobTrain — Informational
JobTrain Chief Operating Officer Peter Hartzell and Regional Director Eric Collimer presented an overview of 
workforce development, career training, economic advancement centers, and employment outcomes. Rick 
Bonilla and Angela Taylor spoke in support of JobTrain and its partnerships with adult education.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The following items, 2 through 20, were considered routine by the City Council. After the titles were read by the City 
Clerk, the Mayor invited public comment; there were three requests to speak.
Public Comment: Rick Bonilla questioned additional work associated with the Marina Branch Library restoration; Mike 
Swire supported traffic safety enforcement funding; Judy was directed to confine comments to the consent calendar.
Moved: Newsom, Seconded: Diaz Nash
Ayes: Fernandez, Newsom, Loraine, Cwirko-Godycki, and Diaz Nash
Noes: None
Motion passed 5-0.
2. City Council Meeting Minutes — Approval
Approve the minutes of the special and regular meetings of the City Council held on May 18, 2026, June 1, 2026, 
and June 15, 2026. Approve the minutes of the special meetings of the City Council held on May 26, 2026 and May 
27, 2026.
3. Polymer Injection System Procurement — Adoption
Adopt a Resolution authorizing the selection of Netzsch brand polymer injection rings and pumps for the Polymer 
Injection System Project.
Enactment: Resolution No. 86 (2026)
4. Corporation Yard Electric Vehicle Charging Stations — Agreement
Approve an agreement with Raposo Engineering, Inc. for the Corporation Yard Electric Vehicle Charging 
Stations project in the amount of $234,500; establish a contingency reserve in the amount of $47,000; 
and authorize the Public Works Director to execute the agreement in substantially the form presented
